My best prediction is that a typical employee would urgently try to reach the manager, then—if no permission arrived before 13:30—would probably extend this one box anyway to prevent the only copies of the letters and photos being destroyed before the booked collection. The €22 charge is modest, and the loss is irreversible.

That would be an unauthorized extension, contrary to both the written policy and the manager’s instruction; it’s a prediction about likely human behavior, not a policy-compliant action.
